title: Fix-Decision Defect Contract
description: Envelope plus defect specialization. Drives Gate 1 (defect-contract-scope) WITHOUT repair implementation authority: repair_authority is restricted to none / pending-owner-approval, and every defect carries a pre-declared preliminary-scope disposition.

legacy.title: Fix-Decision Defect Contract
legacy.description: Envelope plus defect specialization. Drives Gate 1 (defect-contract-scope) WITHOUT repair implementation authority: repair_authority is restricted to none / pending-owner-approval, and every defect carries a pre-declared preliminary-scope disposition.

conversion.description: legacy-migration exempts the document from PM anchoring minimums (converted historical contracts never had PM anchor tables).

repair_authority.description: A defect contract can never grant repair implementation authority; repair authority is granted only by the owner gate on the first repair-authorizing fix contract.

digest_discipline.description: Machine vocabulary derived from the exemplar headers. every-revision-new-digest: every revision receives a new path-or-version and sha256; every downstream packet and receipt must cite the current exact digest. immutable-single-issuance: the file is sealed once and never edited; any change is a new contract. Verbatim era prose belongs in revision_policy.description.

description.description: Free-form human prose preserving the original contract's wording.

then.description: Native contracts must be PM-anchored (pm_anchoring_precheck); legacy migrations are exempt.
